stem: The volume, in millilitres, of a small cup of coffee has the distribution $\text{N}(103.4, 10.2)$. The volume of a large cup of coffee is 1.5 times the volume of a small cup of coffee.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the mean and standard deviation of the volume of a large cup of coffee.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total volume of a randomly chosen small cup of coffee and a randomly chosen large cup of coffee is greater than 250 ml.
